budgets.title: one rate lookup per currency, not per item
budgets.why: There are four currencies and two hundred items. The rate for EUR does not change between one item and the next, so asking for it two hundred times is asking a question already answered.

budgets.title: one score per item, not one per comparison
budgets.why: The ranking recomputes both keys on every comparison of a hand-rolled selection sort, so cost grows with the square of the group. Score each item once and sort by what you computed.

budgets.title: the group report pays for each fact once
budgets.why: Both wastes at once: a rate lookup per item, and a score recomputed on each side of every comparison. Neither input changes while the report is being built.
